description: This file defines a WebSocket connection manager class named `ConnectionManager` used for real-time game state synchronization in a networked game application. It handles WebSocket connections, grouping them by game IDs, and provides methods for connecting, disconnecting, broadcasting messages, sending personal messages, and retrieving connection counts.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connections for real-time game updates, allowing targeting and broadcasting of messages to clients grouped by game ID.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the connection manager with an empty connection pool.

methods.name: connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, game_id: str)
methods.description: Accepts a WebSocket connection and registers it under a specified game ID.

methods.name: disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket, game_id: str)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection from the pool for a specified game ID.

methods.name: broadcast_to_game(self, game_id: str, message: dict)
methods.description: Broadcasts a JSON message to all WebSocket clients connected to a specific game.

methods.name: send_personal_message(self, websocket: WebSocket, message: dict)
methods.description: Sends a JSON message to a specific WebSocket client.

methods.name: int get_connection_count(self, game_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the number of active connections for a specific game ID.

methods.name: int get_total_connections(self)
methods.description: Returns the total number of active WebSocket connections across all games.

ctags.name: broadcast_to_game
ctags.pattern: /^    async def broadcast_to_game(self, game_id: str, message: dict):$/

ctags.name: connect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, game_id: str):$/

ctags.pattern: /^    def disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket, game_id: str):$/

ctags.pattern: /^    async def send_personal_message(self, websocket: WebSocket, message: dict):$/
